definitions: An officer of middle rank in the armed forces, in particular (in the US Army, Air Force, and Marine Corps) an officer ranking above captain and below lieutenant colonel, or (in the British Army and Royal Marines) an officer ranking above captain and below lieutenant colonel.
A subject or course of study chosen by a student as their main specialization.
A person who is of legal age.
examples: She was promoted to major last year.
He is now a major and can sign the contract.
